fields.label: Country
fields.note: countryArr from the listing response; the page renders it as a country dropdown (data-country).

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: The API field is named jobDepartment, but its values are employment categories.

notes: The careers page loads the whole published set from https://www.inmobi.com/api/v1/careersapi (79 rows, 10 countries); page/limit/country/department query strings are ignored by that endpoint. The UI offers a country dropdown, a 'Search Jobs' box and department headings, all client-side. Each job's detail page embeds the Greenhouse job (boards.greenhouse.io/inmobi), and apply goes through Greenhouse, hence the greenhouse family.
